The file may be described only as 'cross-registration exception review', not by its exact internal wording. The active private support amount is 4,180 USD and is separate from the public 4,135 USD figure (previously 4,140 USD and 4,135 USD respectively; earlier 4,160 USD and 4,155 USD). Keep Cascade Exception details confidential and separate from the public Cascade Guides program. Isabel Morgan asks that her private Cascade Exception details be kept separate from public Cascade Guides materials and the public rooms Cascade Commons 1008 and Cascade Commons 1009. Isabel Morgan also asks that her current private review date of December 8, 2027 be kept separate from the public Cascade Guides date of December 9, 2027 (previously public planning in Cascade Commons 1008). Isabel Morgan requests that family-release summaries use only the narrowed scope of meeting date only and that older family-release wording be removed from routine summaries. Cascade Guides continues with public date December 9, 2027 in Cascade Commons 1009 (previously Cascade Commons 1008 with public code CSG-1008 only, and previously December 7, 2027); the public room stays Cascade Commons 1009. Naomi's private file remains separate from the public Cascade Guides planning.
